Platforms: iOS
Emitted when the sensor witnesses a process is running. This event is not an indication that a process just started, only that the process was first seen running
when the event was sent. It is used for iOS where there is no way to be notified of processes start or running, or to query about running processes, and the
sensor only knows a process exists when it makes a network connection. This event is therefore different from PR2s or SynPR2s.
